remarks: Spacious South Wilton Rental Set Back from the Road with 3,800+ Sq Ft of Living - Tucked back from Westport Road in sought-after South Wilton, this inviting single-family rental offers the perfect balance of privacy, comfort, and generous living space. With 4 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, the home spans approx. 3,839 square feet, providing plenty of room to live, work, and relax. The thoughtful layout includes expansive living areas ideal for everyday living as well as entertaining. At the end of the day, retreat to the large primary suite, offering a peaceful and private escape. Outside, a level backyard provides the perfect setting for outdoor enjoyment, whether it's relaxing, entertaining, or simply taking in the quiet surroundings. Set back from the road, the property offers a sense of tranquility while still being conveniently located to Wilton amenities, commuting routes, and neighboring Westport. With its combination of space, privacy, and location, this home offers an exceptional rental opportunity in one of Wilton's most desirable areas. Come experience the comfort and setting of this special home - schedule your private showing today.
